WarmDogo

Website

Who they are

WarmDogo is an AI outbound agent for LinkedIn. Its assistant 'Dogo' monitors LinkedIn for buying signals (people engaging with your or competitors' posts, naming a problem you solve, companies hiring for a target role), scores each person against your ICP, and sends a daily list of warm leads with a reason each was picked. Tagline 'Get warm leads from LinkedIn.' Targets founders doing their own outbound + sales teams/agencies. Free tier (50 leads, no card).

What they want

  • (No formal UGC brief beyond the job post — angle inferred from the product + the 'WarmDogo Creator Campaign / High Volume UGC, $30/post' listing; swap in the real brief anytime.)
  • Angle to model: B2B sales / lead-gen content that bridges into WarmDogo — 'how I fill my pipeline', warm-vs-cold outreach, 'I stopped cold-emailing and did this', founder-led outbound, day-in-the-life SDR, 'how to get clients from LinkedIn'.
  • Why it converts: WarmDogo turns LinkedIn signals into a daily list of people already in-market — lead with the pain of cold outreach falling flat, then show warm, reason-scored leads landing in your lap.
  • Study below: the competitor cards + keyword sections show the sales / cold-outreach / lead-gen formats that go viral on short-form, so you can replicate the winners.
